fields.statement: At e89dc1ca, ran go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api -run 'TestWatchdogRequests$' -v: PASS. The test drives watchdogRequests over fake journals and a fake resume: request r1 whose plan run is unended and not live (gone, still planning) is resumed; r3 whose plan run failed on a git index.lock transient signature is retried (resume --retry, logged with the signature); r4 failed with 'exit 1' is not resumed (left for the owner); the live run, a milestone request and an unstarted request are untouched; a second poll with RetryBudget 1 resumes nothing. Read the diff: the pass is wired into watchdogPasses via daemon.ReadRequests, shares the per-run budget memory and the continue queue check, skips runs the failed-transient pass already owns, and leaves planned (succeeded) requests alone. Also ran the whole -run TestWatchdog set: every test passes; the package then reports the known pre-existing usage.live.json leak into ~/code/.rhiza-root, which TestWatchdogRequests alone does not trigger.
